work.faelune.task.collector.desc: No tool needed. Picks up ground items inside the radius and stores them in the beacon.

book.faelune.guide.page.1:
§5§lFaelune Guide§0

Faelune is a small stellar companion who can follow you, fight by your side and work for you.

§8Turn the page to begin.
book.faelune.guide.page.2:
§5§lTaming§0

Give her §6cookies§0: each one has a 1 in 3 chance.

A §dstellar cookie§0 tames her on the first try and fully heals her.

Regular cookies heal her too.
book.faelune.guide.page.3:
§5§lCommands§0

§lRight-click§0: sit or stand.

§lSneak + right-click§0: open her inventory.

If you get too far away, she teleports to you.
book.faelune.guide.page.4:
§5§lInventory§0

15 storage slots, one §lweapon or tool§0 slot and two §larmor§0 slots: chestplate and leggings.

§lON/OFF§0: pick up ground items.

§c❤§0: self-heal with stellar cookies.
book.faelune.guide.page.5:
§5§lCombat§0

She attacks whatever you attack and whatever attacks you.

Her damage depends on her weapon: a sword or axe hits much harder.
book.faelune.guide.page.6:
§5§lStellar Beacon§0

Her work station. It has 27 storage slots where Faelune drops off what she gathers.

In its screen you pick the task and the radius (4-16).
book.faelune.guide.page.7:
§5§lLinking§0

1. Right-click your Faelune with the §dStellar Tuner§0.

2. Right-click the beacon.

§lSneak + right-click§0 Faelune with the tuner: unlink.
book.faelune.guide.page.8:
§5§lTasks (1)§0

§2§lLumberjack§0 (axe): chops the base and the whole tree falls, leaves included. Replants saplings.

§6§lFarmer§0 (hoe): harvests mature crops, replants them and sows farmland.
book.faelune.guide.page.9:
§5§lTasks (2)§0

§4§lGuard§0 (weapon): attacks hostile mobs in the radius, except creepers.

§1§lCollector§0: picks up ground items.

§8§lFree§0: follows you.
book.faelune.guide.page.10:
§5§lTips§0

She won't work while sitting.

Better tools or armor in the beacon? She equips them and leaves hers there. She also takes saplings and seeds.

When full, she empties her inventory into the beacon.
book.faelune.guide.page.11:
§5§lRecipes§0

§lBeacon§0: 3 amethyst shards, glowstone, ender pearl, 3 iron ingots.

§lTuner§0: amethyst, iron and redstone.

§lStellar cookie§0: cookie, glowstone dust and amethyst.
book.faelune.guide.page.12:
§5§lStellar Hopper§0

A hopper with 3 §lfilter§0 slots: put an item in them and it will only pick up those items, 4 times faster than a normal hopper. Without a filter it picks up nothing.

§lRecipe§0: hopper, 3 amethyst shards and glowstone dust.
